buildCheck: 4 lessons, 24 questions, 16 audio requests, zero mechanical flags

lessonReviews.summary: The safety/independence source sense, target use, six keys, bilingual material and scenario transfer are sound. Writing model 1 omits the required publication of the pool hours.

Displacement and lost belonging are grounded in the school-change source sense and transferred to housing, work and market contexts. Four replies are defensible; both models and translations preserve improvement alongside emotional loss.

The figurative confidence sense, target and keyed answers are sound. Both writing models omit the guide's hesitation before her next tour; model 2 also omits the colleague checking the dates. The scene invents a female owner when the Chinese prompt only says 店主.
Both beneficial and burdensome conditions are assessed, including the not-yet-confirmed phone option; source sense, bilingual models, exact glossary and target are coherent.

findings.requiredRepair: Add a concise announcement condition to model 1 in English and Traditional Chinese; recalculate glossary offsets if affected.
